name: Cua Computer-Use REPL
description: Drives the trycua/cua computer-use agent REPL (`python -m cua_agent.cli`) from aish — interactive TTY sessions, one-shot prompts, click prediction, and a preflight doctor for the cloud/lume/winsandbox/docker sandbox providers.

python.description: Python interpreter (>=3.11,<3.14) that has cua-agent installed. Exported to scripts as CUA_PYTHON.

model.description: Default model string passed to the REPL, e.g. anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929, openai/computer-use-preview, omniparser+anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929.

provider.description: cua-sandbox computer provider. cloud attaches to a named Cua container; the rest are local VMs/containers.

container_name.description: Sandbox name. Exported as CUA_CONTAINER_NAME so the REPL never has to prompt for it interactively.

credential_profile.description: Name of the ~/.aish/credentials [profile:*] section holding CUA_API_KEY (and optionally ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY). Secrets are referenced as ${profile:KEY} and NEVER inlined.

budget_usd.description: Hard per-session spend cap handed to --budget. The REPL raises once the trajectory exceeds it.

images.description: Number of recent screenshots kept in model context (--images). Lower = cheaper.

show_usage.description: Pass -u/--usage so each turn prints running cost.

trajectory.description: Pass --trajectory to persist a replayable trajectory under ./trajectories.

extra_args.description: Raw extra flags appended to every invocation (e.g. "--cache --max-retries 5"). Exported as CUA_REPL_ARGS.

tools.name: cua_repl
tools.description: Start the Cua computer-use REPL, or run a single prompt headlessly with -p "…".

tools.name: cua_doctor
tools.description: Preflight the Cua REPL: interpreter, cua-agent/cua-sandbox imports, CLI extra, env vars, provider prerequisites.
